title: Nvidia Boss Admits to Affair With Suspected Chinese Spy
text:
In recent years Jensen Huang has become a rock star in the tech world. But now the chips are down for the Nvidia boss – with shares in his company down eight percent at one point after he admitted having an affair with a woman suspected to be a Chinese spy. According to the New York Times, President Trump was briefed a year ago that US intelligence believed she was a Chinese operative, but did nothing about it.Watch the full interview on 4News.
